p.n: Friendship Is Pursued For a Need

body.p:
And so
in these situations, the sensible man always holds back a need of the other as a guarantee against what he fears; and on the whole, people’s connections and experiences
only exist to seek an immediate or deferred benefit.

“When morning came, “he continued,“
the cat and the rat noticed the huntsman had approached their place from afar, so the rat said

p.n: The Rat Resolves to Cut the Last Rope

body.p:

I will diligently cut what is left of your cords.’”
